budgetyourtrip_one_star_average.evidenceText: Average 1-Star Hotel Price in Rome, Italy: $137 is the average price of the 2,061 1-star hotels in Rome, and the median price is $122.
budgetyourtrip_one_star_average.searchQuery: site:budgetyourtrip.com Rome Italy 1-star hotel average nightly price
budgetyourtrip_one_star_average.reason: Accepted as an exact Rome city-wide 1-star nightly statistic with a visible 2,061-hotel sample and USD currency. Occupancy is unknown because the result does not establish a two-adult/one-room basis. A separate expensive-page result reported zero 1-star hotels and was rejected under the strict contract.
